items.markdown:
Sudden or premature graying happens when hair follicles stop producing [melanin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greying_of_hair) , the pigment that gives hair its color.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greying_of_hair)

### Primary Causes

- **Genetics:** Family history is the most common reason for early or fast graying.
- **Stress:** High or chronic stress releases a chemical called norepinephrine, which damages or depletes the melanocyte stem cells that control hair color.
- **Nutritional Deficiencies:** Low levels of [Vitamin B12](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226) , Vitamin D, iron, copper, or ferritin can interrupt pigment production.
- **Autoimmune Conditions:** Diseases like vitiligo, alopecia areata, or thyroid disorders can attack or damage pigment-producing cells.
- **Smoking:** Chemicals and free radicals from cigarette smoke cause oxidative stress that speeds up follicle aging.[[1]](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DnMBqL8EbNk&t=6)[[3]](https://nutritionfacts.org/video/reversible-causes-of-prematurely-graying-hair/)[[4]](https://neofollics.com/blogs/articles/grey-hair)[[5]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6290285/)[[6]](https://patient.info/features/skin-conditions/why-hair-turns-grey-and-how-lifestyle-may-play-a-role)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DUzJa5A80LY&t=28)[[8]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226)[[9]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/gray-hair)[[10]](https://www.healthline.com/health/white-hair)[[11]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/why-hair-turns-gray)

### Reversibility

- **Permanent:** Age-related graying and standard genetic greying cannot be reversed.
- **Potentially Reversible:** If graying is linked to a Vitamin B12 deficiency or a [thyroid condition](https://nutritionfacts.org/video/reversible-causes-of-prematurely-graying-hair/) , treating the underlying issue with medical care or supplements can sometimes restore normal hair color. According to the [American Academy of Dermatology](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes) , no direct medical treatments exist to turn gray hair back to its original shade once the follicle stops making pigment.[[1]](https://patient.info/features/skin-conditions/why-hair-turns-grey-and-how-lifestyle-may-play-a-role)[[2]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/gray-hair)[[3]](https://joshwoodcolour.com/blogs/community/what-actually-causes-grey-hair-here-s-what-the-experts-have-to-say)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DnMBqL8EbNk&t=6)[[5]](https://nutritionfacts.org/video/reversible-causes-of-prematurely-graying-hair/)[[6]](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes)
